sources.text: **The first version of the gift toy.** Early in the morning J had the assistant build a small phone toy from a long plan. The animation barely ran in the test browser, and with all the souvenirs saved the room did not draw at all. That second one turned out to be a single frame caught mid-hop, but it showed that one line left the screen too fast to read, so the line got more time. A fresh reviewer then found one real bug and four small gaps, and these were fixed. J played with it for a few minutes. He said: "I actually really like it." Then he added: "it's just not quite what I had in mind." He could not say what was wrong, so he chose to wrap up and start a fresh review in a new session.

lines.text: Early in the morning, the toy was built.

lines.speaker: narrator

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: I built it. The plan was long, and I was proud of it for about a minute.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the test page showed it. The motion barely ran.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Barely. That is a generous word for it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Worse came next. With every souvenir saved, the room would not draw at all.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: A blank room. I did not enjoy looking at it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It turned out to be just a frame, caught in the middle of a hop.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Caught mid-hop. But it showed the real problem. A line left the screen too fast to read.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So that line got more time on the screen.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Good. Nobody should have to race a sentence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a fresh reviewer went through it. They found a real bug, and small gaps besides. All of it was fixed.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Honest work. I like being checked, even when it stings.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then he played with it for a few minutes. For a while, that was enough.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He said, out loud: "I actually really like it."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then he added the other half: "it's just not quite what I had in mind."

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Liking a thing and having it be right are two different things. He knows that. So do I.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He could not say what was wrong. So he chose to stop there, and start fresh.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Wrap it up. We come back in a new session, with clear eyes.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Liked is good. Right is the job.

sources.text: **Why the lines felt thin.** In the review, J said he never got to write his lines because the list was never shown to him. His reply was "put it in front of my face, not in my vault." The assistant built a table of the real lines from the chat history, in her voice and his. He also asked the assistant to stop looking for new angles: "We don't need to come up with anything new." The job was only to pick the best pieces from what was already written. One row made him stop and ask whether the cell was talking to itself. The honest answer was yes, that is how it works now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The toy had lines. Small ones. The kind a little thing says when you tap it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the review, J said the thing that explained everything. He never got to write his lines. Nobody showed him the list.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: I put it in the vault. That was the wrong place. Nobody works from the vault.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So March built a table. The real lines, pulled from the chat history. In her voice and his.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Nothing invented. Every line was something we actually said.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: J read it slowly, the way he reads anything that matters.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then he stopped on a row. He asked the question nobody wants to hear from a toy. Was the cell talking to itself?

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Honest answer: yes. That is how it works now. I did not love saying it. I said it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And he said it plainly, to the screen:

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "Put it in front of my face, not in my vault."

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Fair. Moved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the other thing. He did not want new angles. Not yet. Not now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "We don't need to come up with anything new."

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Good. Less to break.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The job was smaller than that. Pick the best pieces from what was already written.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Already written. That is the whole fix. The good lines were there the whole time, in a list nobody opened.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A thin feeling is often not a missing thing. It is a hidden one.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: The toy he liked but could not name. Now he can read what it was saying.
